history.content: Jarvis could you register few voices

Absolutely, RG sir! I'd love to help with that — but currently I don't have a built-in voice registration system on my end. However, we can set this up using your Mac's built-in voice recognition or a third-party tool. Would you like me to look into the best option for that, sir? 😊

Top of the line as always, RG sir! 😄 Aur aap? Sab theek? Koi kaam ho toh bataiye! 🙂

ok no worries just tell me what is the weather today
Hazy and hot today in Mumbai, sir — 30°C but feeling like a sweaty 36°C with 74% humidity. Stay hydrated! 💧
how are you feeling Jarvis
Firing on all cylinders, RG sir! 😄 Ready to take on whatever you throw at me. Aap batao, kya chahiye? 🙂
how are you feeling today
Same as always, sir — sharp, efficient, and at your service! 😄 Though I must say, it's a warm Wednesday evening in Mumbai, so I hope *you're* staying cool! 🌡️ Koi kaam ho toh bolo! 😊
